settings.title: Settings
settings.remember_tip: When on, the model, language, switches and advanced options are saved to the JSON file below and restored on the next launch. When off, nothing is written and saved options are ignored.
settings.mcp_tip: Turning this off releases the port immediately and MCP clients show as disconnected; turn it back on to recover — no restart needed. It only listens on localhost.
settings.coreml_tip: When on, whisper-cli loads the CoreML encoder next to the model. When off it uses Metal + CPU: slower, but quicker to start and lighter on memory.
settings.coreml_missing: No CoreML encoder was found next to this model, so this switch is unavailable.
settings.concurrency_tip: How many transcriptions run at once: default 2, max 100. Each one loads roughly 550 MB of model and encoder, so higher values eat memory and CPU; too high can slow or freeze the app. Also adjustable in the task window.
settings.debug_tip: When on, every transcription writes its own log under the folder below with arguments, every whisper-cli output line, progress and the failure reason; app start and MCP toggles are logged too. Nothing is written when off. Logs may contain local file paths — delete them after troubleshooting.
settings.ffmpeg_tip: Media tags, covers and conversion use the bundled static FFmpeg / ffprobe — nothing to install.

about.name: Maplefall
about.author: Made by flwllu
about.note: A local audio/video utility: transcription runs on whisper.cpp, vocal separation on UVR MDX, decoding and conversion on the bundled FFmpeg. Everything happens on your machine — no network calls.
about.attribution: The UVR-MDX-NET-Inst_HQ_3 separation model was trained and released by the Ultimate Vocal Remover project (Anjok07, aufr33 and contributors) under the MIT license; copyright stays with its authors. This app bundles it unmodified, claims no rights over it, and has no affiliation with or endorsement from that project.
about.third_party_body: Bundled FFmpeg / ffprobe (GPL-2.0-or-later, including libx264 and libx265) are invoked as separate child processes and are not linked into this app's code; their corresponding source is available from ffmpeg.org or on request from the developer (offer valid for three years). whisper.cpp, Silero VAD and the UVR-MDX-NET model are MIT-licensed, copyright their respective authors. The full GPL text and complete notices ship with the app.

adv.title: Advanced
adv.tip: Blank means default; changes are saved automatically. Providing a prompt enables context carry-over — otherwise the prompt has no effect.

adv.nofallback: Disable temperature fallback (less hallucination, may stay empty)
